title: Check Distances Between Same Letters
summary: Given a string s with each letter appearing exactly twice, and an array distance of length 26, determine if the string is well-spaced.
statement: Given a string s with each letter appearing exactly twice, and an array distance of length 26, determine if the string is well-spaced. Each letter's position difference between its two occurrences must match the corresponding value in distance. If a letter does not appear in s, its distance value is ignored.
constraints: Every letter used in s appears exactly twice.
For a letter at alphabet index i, exactly distance[i] characters must lie between its occurrences.
hints: Remember the index of each letter’s first occurrence.
At its second occurrence, the number between is current-first-1.
Compare that gap with distance[ord(letter)-ord(a)] and reject any mismatch.
Every used letter is checked exactly at its second occurrence, so accepting means all required gaps match.
editorial: Every used letter is checked exactly at its second occurrence, so accepting means all required gaps match.

tests.explanation: The gaps for a, b, and c equal one, three, and zero respectively.
The two a characters have gap zero, not the required one.
